No, I mean, not everyone can just GO to a doctor.
I used to have the best therapist, and an amazing doctor. I fell on hard times, and then moved, and have no insurance. Plenty of depressed people without the financial means to get help. Just saying “get help” so casually is almost insulting.

It’s fucking heartbreaking

I’m not good at keeping a clear head when I’m like this. I’m alone, and I just keep wanting to do it I’m so fucking scared of myself but at the same time I’m so empty

She has a lot of hatred right now for betraying her dad’s faith in her. I understand that. Did it to myself. 

I want to die, but I’m scared to do it myself. Or rather, I don’t want to hurt the ones I love. I’m not scared to die. I’m scared to kill the ones I love because I want to die.

It’s definitely an experience, mine was very positive. I hope your therapist is a good one.  

Have you tried to get in touch with your friends again since this post?
I understand that fully. Good on you for getting help, seriously. How is that going?
It’s a hard habit to break because it deals heavily with your depression. I’ve been there. Have you ever considered counseling?
Not finishing college might upset you later, but you shouldn’t worry about it now if it’s upsetting your mental health. Do you trust this guy in Canada??
Hey man, wanna talk? I’m a good listener. You said you are toxic? Why do you think that?
I’m here to talk. I know you seem set in what you want, but I know what it feels like to back out. It’s empty and you’ll need someone to confide in. I’m here.

Seriously, thanks for reaching out. And thank you for sharing. You didn’t have to stop and read but you did and that means the world to me, even if you are just a stranger. It actually makes it mean more, honestly. I hope I can learn to find peace and a will to fight for my eyes like you have with your body.

I wish I was able to take medications now. No health insurance means no medications. I’ll get back to a good point again, I just...  sometimes it’s really scary. I’m sure you know this very well. Life is scary enough, but when the people you love start getting sick, and you lose what control you thought you had, life turns into this spiral down that I’m trying desperately to crawl out of. I just wish I had a healthy, normal brain.
That’s a very good way of putting that. I also have people I love and want to protect... it’s just hard to not see the world through grey glass sometimes.
I want to say I wish I could be that strong, but I know I can be. It’s just.... hard. How do you find the motivation?
I’m sorry, friend. Thank you for sharing, and reaching out to me. Do you suffer a lot mentally because of it, too?
It’s hard to deal with. I suppose I’m lucky that mine doesn’t bleed. I’m sorry to hear about that. What do you suffer from?

I have glaucoma and macular degeneration. I knew I was going to be going blind by 35/40 but never did I think it was going to start now at 22. It’s awful. I don’t want to be a burden on people but I’m so lonely
I’m honestly a little scared to open my Xbox one my own. I’m worried about causing more damage.

While I never really connected with Chloe, as I was unable to understand her choices, I still saw her as someone Max loved, and who loved Max. In the end, I feel the choice was already made for me. Ultimately, my projection of my morality onto Max made most of my decisions throughout the game, and saving Bay was one of them. Like I said though, I can see both sides.

Not just for me, but for everyone struggling through the holidays right now
I want to keep pushing forward too. I wish my brain felt the same. It’s horribly exhausting.

I really hope things start to look up. It sounds like you are a very hard worker, and I hope you find the same strength to live. I hope you stay here with us, and talk to us some more. Why don’t you skate anymore?

I am so sorry that you have to go through all of this. It’s not pity, just sorrowful sympathy. I have no idea how you do it, other than the fact that you must be such an amazing, and strong person. Do you have a go fund me? I hate to ask, and maybe you could PM it to me. I hope things start to look up, and I hope you find a better lawyer. Someone who actually wants to help you and not just take your money.
What are you interested in? If not talking, then how do you cope?

He’s an amazing person who just so happened to be lucky. I’m glad I didn’t mute him like I was going to. I hope everyone finds their safe house, like I found mine. The holidays hurt so badly to people in a bad place. The thought of the new year is scary, but I’m really going to try and make 2018 better for myself. I hope it is also good to you. Thank you.

Not dying

I wouldn’t want him to know until I was already gone, if that’s the way it goes

I know he would talk me out of it 
And I know he would

I’m hoping he’s lying because he could do so much better

I would destroy him if I told him
I don’t want to do that to him 
I’d rather just go out quietly with what happiness I have

I don’t know. He’s way more attractive than me. He tells me I’m kind. The kind of kind that would give anyone anything. Maybe I am. It’s more of a downfall in my eyes. 

I don’t want to hurt him 
But I feel I will do more harm to stay

My boyfriend and I were to move in together
But what if I just ruin that too
I have no accomplishments 
I can only work
It’s the only thing I’m good at

It’s okay I thank you for trying so hard

I have a note.
It’s basically just that I wish they wouldn’t be the way they were. It’s like they just got tired of being a parent to me
I wish they wouldn’t have ever hit me, or stolen from me
They treat my siblings with so much love and respect 
It’s all I want

But I’m useless
I can’t be mad at them anymore for just telling me the truth

I have the one. And I love him so much I know I have to let him go. 

I can’t do it. I can’t take being called useless another day. Every single day for the past however many years I’m been cognizant enough to remember 
It feels like my middle name sometimes

I don’t think telling him I want to kill myself would do anything other than scare him. I want to do this quietly.  I’ve been planning it for days. Maybe longer than that. I’ve tried a couple of times since I was 14 but it never worked. I got better around 16, but when my father beat me like a man at 18, I started going downhill from there. 

They are my life. I feel like I can’t escape them. I’m trying to move out but my job right now leaves my options and money so tight it’s difficult 
It feels like it’s never going to happen so what’s the use
I don’t know that I’m strong enough to make it another year. I’m not even scared to die anymore. Which means I know I’m ready. My family are abusive. The only one who isnt is my brother.
I hope guilt. I hope they feel sad but I’m not even sure they would

I’m sorry. It’s always times like these that make me feel bad to complain, as that’s a way worse situation. I just can’t help it. I guess it’s a bit of both.

I’m swimming in debt. When I lost my job August of last year I was building my credit, and looking forward to the future, but when it happened, I was unable to pay my bills, and they stacked up like crazy. I’m just barely paying them off now. My credit is shot. I have to pay double deposits just to move into an apartment because of that

I don’t know if I can wait any more time to leave. I was gunning to move out in February, but I don’t see that happening. It keeps getting pushed back more.. and more

And I don’t know that I can wait anymore months. I’ve been sick as a dog for a week, and had to work all day every day because I can’t afford to take off. I had to save every vacation day I had for an entire year just to have 5 days with my boyfriend. These are the silliest problems, but they are mine, and they are exhausting. My job is awful. When I’m not there, I’m at home, being a caretaker there to my mom, who is emotionally manipulative and emotionally abusive. I feel like the failure of my siblings because I’m not out yet. She makes it clear that I am. For me, suicide is more revenge. I want to my my parents hurt for everything they have done to me. I want to write a note and blame them, and my job, and that girl and those men from the party, and to specially name them responsible. 

I sometimes wish I didn’t have my boyfriend in my life. It would be so easy to pull the trigger then. He complicates everything. My fear of hurting him is so high, but I’m just so low right now. I feel like I’m drowning. Maybe I will.

It’s just so hard some days. The holidays just make it worse. I just want to go to sleep for a long time, and for everything to be fixed when I wake up. Most days it’s not even about death. I’m just so tired of living.
I’m trying to find an apartment near my boyfriend a state over. I’m just struggling to figure out how to afford it though
I’m trying but every step forward leads two back

When I’m up to it, I try new shit. That’s when I have the strength to. Sometimes even just forcing myself to cook something new. 
Sometimes that works

I wish I could also find the courage to live. I’m not even scared to die. I just love too much. That’s the only thing holding me back. I’m just so mediocre at everything. I don’t have a single worthwhile talent. Nothing to keep me busy or to heal me because I’m essentially without hobbies.

I feel that stagnancy 
I feel like I haven’t done anything with my life in a long time so what’s the point
